success_patterns: Hotel searches must wait for explicit check-in and check-out dates, even when the city, amenities, rating, or party details are supplied.
Flight routes and phrases such as “last-minute,” “round-trip,” or “group booking” do not supply missing departure dates; ask for them rather than guessing.
Restaurant searches need an explicit city; dietary preferences alone are not enough to proceed.

patch.reasoning: These recurring clarification needs are already covered by the skill’s missing-mandatory-information rules, including explicit hotel dates, flight departure dates, restaurant city, and the prohibition on inferring defaults. Adding more wording would duplicate existing guidance.
